title: 해양수산생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙

rows.source_ko: 해양수산부 (해양수산생명자원과), 051-773-5671, 5672
rows.text_en: Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries ( Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources Division ), 051-773-5671, 5672

rows.source_ko: 제1장 총칙
rows.text_en: Chapter 1 General Provisions

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 「해양수산생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률」 및 같은 법 시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Act on the Acquisition, Management and Use, etc. of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , as well as matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(해외 해양수산생명자원의 확보방법) 「해양수산생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률」(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제2조제11호에 따라 대한민국 관할수역 외측에서 해양수산생명자원을 확보하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 방법에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Methods for Securing Overseas Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources) In cases where marine and fisheries biological resources are to be secured outside the jurisdictional waters of the Republic of Korea pursuant to Article 2, subparagraph 11 of the “Act on the Securing, Management and Use, etc. of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources” (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), the following methods shall be followed.

rows.source_ko: 1. 직접수집을 통한 확보방법
rows.text_en: 1. Method of securing through direct collection

rows.source_ko: 가. 공해(公海)의 경우: 국제협약 및 조약 등에서 정한 바에 따른 직접수집
rows.text_en: a. In the case of the high seas: Direct collection as stipulated in international conventions and treaties

rows.source_ko: 나. 그 밖의 수역의 경우: 해당 수역에 대하여 관할권이 있는 국가에서 정한 절차에 따른 직접수집
rows.text_en: B. For other waters: Direct collection in accordance with procedures established by the state having jurisdiction over the relevant waters

rows.source_ko: 2. 간접수집을 통한 확보방법
rows.text_en: 2. Method of securing through indirect collection

rows.source_ko: 가. 해외 해양수산생명자원 관련 기관을 통한 간접수집
rows.text_en: a. Indirect collection through overseas institutions related to marine and fisheries biological resources

rows.source_ko: 나. 해양수산생명자원에 대한 국제 공동연구ㆍ조사를 통한 간접수집
rows.text_en: B. Indirect collection through international joint research and surveys on marine and fisheries biological resources

rows.source_ko: 제2장 해양수산생명자원관리기본계획 등
rows.text_en: Chapter 2 Basic Plan for the Management of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(해양수산생명자원에 대한 조사방법 등) ① 「해양수산생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제3조제1항에 따른 해양수산생명자원에 대한 조사방법은 다음 각 호와 같다. <개정 2021. 6. 30.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Investigation Methods, etc. for Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources) ① The investigation methods for marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Acquisition, Management, and Utilization, etc. of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) are as follows: <Amended June 30, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제7조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 해양수산생명자원에 대한 기초조사 및 정밀조사는 식물, 동물, 미생물 및 그 밖의 기원(起源)물질로 구분하여 실시할 것. 다만, 현지의 환경 특성 등에 따라 그 구분을 일부 변경할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: 1. Basic and detailed surveys of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 7 , Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Act shall be conducted by classifying them into plants, animals, microorganisms, and other source materials. However, the classification may be partially changed depending on local environmental characteristics, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 현지 직접조사는 채수기(물을 퍼 올리는 기구), 그물, 어구 등의 도구 및 잠수 등의 방법을 이용하여 실시할 것
rows.text_en: 2. Direct on-site surveys shall be conducted using tools such as water samplers, nets, and fishing gear, as well as methods such as diving.

rows.source_ko: ② 해양수산부장관은 영 제3조제3항에 따라 해양수산생명자원조사원을 지명하는 경우 그 조사원에게 별지 제1호서식의 해양수산생명자원조사원증을 발급하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries designates a marine and fisheries biological resource researcher pursuant to Article 3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall issue a marine and fisheries biological resource researcher certificate in the form of Annex 1 to the researcher.

rows.source_ko: 제4조(해양수산생명자원의 목록 작성 등) ① 국립수산과학원장 및 「국립해양생물자원관의 설립 및 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 국립해양생물자원관(이하 “국립해양생물자원관”이라 한다)의 장은 법 제9조제3항에 따른 해양수산생명자원의 목록을 작성하는 경우 별지 제2호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Preparation of List of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources, etc.) ① The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science and the head of the National Marine Biological Resources Center pursuant to the Act on the Establishment and Operation of the National Marine Biological Resources Center (hereinafter referred to as the “National Marine Biological Resources Center”) when preparing a list of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 3 of the Act, use Form No. 2 attached hereto.

rows.source_ko: ② 국립수산과학원장 및 국립해양생물자원관의 장은 제1항에 따른 해양수산생명자원의 전체 목록을 해양수산부장관에게 매년 1월 31일까지 제출하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science and the Director of the National Marine Biological Resources Institute shall submit the entire list of marine and fisheries biological resources under Paragraph 1 to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by January 31 of each year.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제17조제1항에 따라 지정된 해양수산생명자원 책임기관(이하 “책임기관”이라 한다)의 장은 제1항에 따른 해양수산생명자원의 목록 중에서 보존 가치가 있는 것을 법 제9조제4항에 따른 해양수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 목록에 등재하는 경우 별지 제3호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the head of the responsible agency for marine and fisheries biological resources designated pursuant to Article 17 , Paragraph 1 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “responsible agency”) lists items of conservation value among the list of marine and fisheries biological resources under Paragraph 1 in the list of conservation and management of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 4 of the Act , he/she shall follow Form No. 3 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제5조(외국인등의 획득 허가 등) ① 영 제7조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따른 해양수산생명자원 획득허가 신청서 및 영 제8조제1항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 공동획득 허가 신청서는 별지 제4호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Permission for Acquisition by Foreigners, etc.) ① The application for permission to acquire marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to the first part of Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree and the application for permission to acquire jointly pursuant to Article 8, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 4 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제7조제3항 각 호 외의 부분 전단에 따른 해양수산생명자원 획득허가증은 별지 제5호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The permit for the acquisition of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to the first part of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제7조제4항에 따라 해양수산생명자원의 획득허가를 받은 선박의 외부에 설치하여야 하는 깃발은 별표 1과 같다. <개정 2025. 4. 9.>
rows.text_en: ③ The flags to be installed on the exterior of a vessel that has received a permit to acquire marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree are as set forth in Annex 1. <Amended Apr. 9, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 제6조(과학적 가치의 손상 없이 분할될 수 있는 기준) 법 제13조제3항제1호에 따라 시료 및 유전물질을 과학적 가치의 손상 없이 분할하려는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 기준을 모두 갖추어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Criteria for Division Without Impairment of Scientific Value) In cases where samples and genetic material are to be divided without impairment of scientific value pursuant to Article 13, Paragraph 3, Subparagraph 1 of the Act , all of the following criteria must be met.

rows.source_ko: 1. 형태적 측면 및 분자생물학적 측면에서 개별 종(種)으로의 판단이 가능할 것
rows.text_en: 1. It will be possible to determine it as an individual species from morphological and molecular biological perspectives.

rows.source_ko: 2. 분자생물학적 측면에서 유전적 특성이 훼손되지 아니할 것
rows.text_en: 2. Genetic characteristics shall not be compromised from a molecular biological perspective.

rows.source_ko: 3. 생리활성(生理活性) 분석을 할 수 있는 형태일 것
rows.text_en: 3. It must be in a form capable of analyzing physiological activity.

rows.source_ko: 제3장 해양수산생명자원의 책임기관의 지정ㆍ운영 등
rows.text_en: Chapter 3 Designation and Operation of Responsible Agencies for Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(해양수산생명자원 기탁등록보존기관의 지정 등) ① 영 제14조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 기탁등록보존기관 지정신청서는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Designation, etc. of Institutions for the Deposit, Registration, and Preservation of Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources) ① The application form for the designation of an institution for the deposit, registration, and preservation of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 14, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제14조제6항에 따른 기탁등록보존기관 지정증서는 별지 제7호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of designation of a deposit registration preservation institution pursuant to Article 14 , Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 7 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제15조제1항에 따른 기탁등록보존기관 재지정신청서는 별지 제6호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The application for redesignation of a deposit registration preservation institution pursuant to Article 15 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 6 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제8조(분양승인 기준 등) 영 제17조제1항제4호에서 “분양수량, 유전적 특성 또는 보전가치 등 해양수산부령으로 정하는 기준”이란 별표 2에 따른 분양수량의 기준을 말한다. 다만, 해양수산부장관이 법 제18조제1항에 따라 지정된 해양수산생명자원 기탁등록보존기관 및 책임기관의 보유 현황을 고려하여 별표 2에 따른 분양수량의 기준을 조정한 경우에는 그 조정된 기준을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Standards for Approval of Distribution, etc.) In Article 17, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, “standards prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, such as distribution quantity, genetic characteristics, or conservation value” refers to the standards for distribution quantity set forth in Annex 2. However, if the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries has adjusted the standards for distribution quantity set forth in Annex 2 in consideration of the holding status of the deposit, registration , and preservation institutions and responsible institutions for marine and fisheries biological resources designated pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall refer to such adjusted standards.
[Wholly revised Apr. 9, 2025]

rows.source_ko: 제9조(분양승인의 절차 등) ① 영 제18조제1항에 따른 해양수산생명자원 분양승인 신청서는 별지 제8호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Procedures for Approval of Distribution, etc.) ① The application for approval of distribution of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 8 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제18조제3항에 따른 해양수산생명자원 분양승인서는 별지 제9호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The approval certificate for the distribution of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 18, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 9 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제19조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 용도변경승인 신청서는 별지 제10호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The application for approval of change of use pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 19 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 10 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제10조(국외반출승인 신청 절차 등) ① 영 제21조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 국외반출승인 신청서는 별지 제11호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Procedure for Application for Approval of Export Abroad, etc.) ① The application for approval of export abroad pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 21 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 11 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제21조제5항에 따른 해양수산생명자원 국외반출승인서는 별지 제12호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The approval for the export of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 21 , Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 12 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제22조제3항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 해양수산생명자원 국외반출신고서는 별지 제13호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ③ The declaration of export of marine and fisheries biological resources abroad pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 22, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 13 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제11조(기탁ㆍ등록 방법) ① 영 제24조제1항에 따른 해양수산생명자원 기탁ㆍ등록신청서는 별지 제14호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Method of Deposit and Registration) ① The application form for deposit and registration of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 24, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 14 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제24조제2항에 따른 해양수산생명자원 기탁ㆍ등록확인증은 별지 제15호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: ② The certificate of deposit and registration of marine and fisheries biological resources pursuant to Article 24 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 15 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제4장 해양수산생명자원에 관한 인프라 구축
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Establishment of Infrastructure for Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources

rows.source_ko: 제12조(해양수산생명자원 관련 기술개발 및 이용촉진 등 지원신청) 영 제26조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 지원신청서는 별지 제16호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Application for Support for Technology Development and Promotion of Use, etc. Related to Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources) The application for support pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 26, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 16 of the Attached Form .

rows.source_ko: 제13조(해외 해양수산생명자원 연구ㆍ개발 등 지원신청) 영 제27조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에 따른 지원신청서는 별지 제17호서식에 따른다.
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Application for Support for Research and Development of Overseas Marine and Fisheries Biological Resources, etc.) The application for support pursuant to the part other than each subparagraph of Article 27, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 17 of the Attached Form .
ADDENDA <Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries Decree No. 241, June 28, 2017>

rows.source_ko: 제1조(시행일) 이 규칙은 2017년 6월 28일부터 시행한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Enforcement Date)  This rule shall enter into force on June 28, 2017.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(다른 법령의 개정) 농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 일부를 다음과 같이 개정한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Amendment of Other Laws)  Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources is amended as follows.

rows.source_ko: 제명 “농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙”을 “농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: The title “Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources” shall be changed to “Enforcement Rules of the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources”.

rows.source_ko: 제1조 중 “「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」”을 “「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」”로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 1, “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources” shall be changed to “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources”.

rows.source_ko: 제2조의 제목 중 “농수산생명자원”을 “농업생명자원”으로 하고, 같은 조 제1항 중 “「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」(이하 "법"이라 한다)”을 “「농업생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률」(이하 "법"이라 한다)”로, “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로, “농수산생명자원의 현황”을 “농업생명자원의 현황”으로 하며, 같은 조 제2항 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로 하고, 같은 조 제3항 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로, “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the title of Article 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”; in Paragraph 1 of the same Article, “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)” shall be changed to “the Act on the Conservation, Management and Utilization of Agricultural Biological Resources (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”)”; “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; and “the current status of agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “the current status of agricultural biological resources”; in Paragraph 2 of the same Article, “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; and in Paragraph 3 of the same Article, “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service, the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and the Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “the Minister of the Korea Forest Service and the Minister of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”. “Agricultural and fisheries biological resources” shall be changed to “Agricultural biological resources” respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제3조의 제목, 같은 조 제1항 각 호 외의 부분, 같은 항 제5호 및 같은 조 제2항 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the title of Article 3, the part other than the subparagraphs of Paragraph 1 of the same article, Subparagraph 5 of the same paragraph, and Paragraph 2 of the same article, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources.”

rows.source_ko: 제4조 및 제5조를 각각 삭제한다.
rows.text_en: Articles 4 and 5 are deleted.

rows.source_ko: 제6조제1항부터 제3항까지 및 제7조제1항ㆍ제2항 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In Article 6, paragraphs 1 through 3, and Article 7, paragraphs 1 and 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources”.

rows.text_en: In the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 8, Paragraph 1, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources,” and in Subparagraph 3 of the same paragraph, “agricultural and fishery biodiversity” shall be changed to “agricultural biodiversity,” and in Paragraph 2 of the same article, “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency and Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service and Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency.”

rows.source_ko: 제9조제1항 및 같은 조 제2항 본문 중 “농수산생명자원”을 각각 “농업생명자원”으로, “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 또는 국립수산과학원장”을 각각 “산림청장 또는 농림축산검역본부장”으로 하고, 같은 조 제2항 단서를 삭제하며, 같은 조 제3항 본문 중 “산림청장, 농림축산검역본부장 및 국립수산과학원장”을 “산림청장 및 농림축산검역본부장”으로 한다.
rows.text_en: In the main text of Article 9, Paragraph 1 and Paragraph 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources” and “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, or Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service or Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”; the proviso to Paragraph 2 of the same article shall be deleted; and in the main text of Paragraph 3 of the same article, “Minister of the Korea Forest Service, Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, and Director of the National Institute of Fisheries Science” shall be changed to “Minister of the Korea Forest Service and Director of the Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency”.

rows.text_en: In Article 10, Paragraphs 1 and 2, “agricultural and fishery biological resources” shall be changed to “agricultural biological resources” respectively.

rows.source_ko: 제3조(다른 법령과의 관계) 이 규칙 시행 당시 다른 법령에서 종전의 「해양생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 및 「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙」의 규정을 인용한 경우 이 규칙 가운데 그에 해당하는 규정이 있을 때에는 종전의 「해양생명자원의 확보ㆍ관리 및 이용 등에 관한 법률 시행규칙」 및 「농수산생명자원의 보존ㆍ관리 및 이용에 관한 법률 시행규칙」을 갈음하여 이 규칙 또는 이 규칙의 해당 규정을 인용한 것으로 본다.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Relationship with Other Laws and Regulations) Where,  at the time of the enforcement of this Rule, other laws and regulations cite the provisions of the former "Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Acquisition, Management, and Utilization of Marine Biological Resources, etc." and the "Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Conservation, Management, and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources," and there are corresponding provisions in this Rule, it shall be deemed that this Rule or the relevant provisions of this Rule have been cited in place of the former "Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Acquisition, Management, and Utilization of Marine Biological Resources, etc." and the "Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Conservation, Management, and Utilization of Agricultural and Fishery Biological Resources."
